body: The two items are bundled beside marked feed sack; field dust lies beneath them, and sticky spray residue and seed husks cling to the bundle.
title: After sack by the kitchen chair, the first copy

body: The jar contains ash beneath its lid, sealed with barrier tape, a numbered evacuation tag tied at its neck. A potato is wrapped in a clean bandage beside it. These were packed together before the fire spread; the jar was being carried out, while the food was left where it could be found.
title: Ash inside the sealed jar
